2.14.2 Rectangle.Style
The Rectangle.Style element specifies style properties for a Rectangle. This element is optional and
is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the Rectangle.Style element.
Parent elements
 Rectangle
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Rectangle.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
